summary: Preinstall script downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package ships a preinstall hook (setup.mjs) that is heavily obfuscated with hex-named identifiers and per-scope string-lookup dictionaries hiding constants such as the download URL, temp path, chmod value, and shell commands. On install, setup.mjs resolves the host platform/architecture, downloads the Bun runtime binary from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<ver>/<arch>.zip, extracts and chmods it 0o755, and then invokes execFileSync(bun, [math_init.js]) to run a sibling 727 KB file. math_init.js is a single-line obfuscated bundle (shuffled string-array rotator, hex identifiers) with no readable purpose. The package's advertised purpose is a Vue dropdown UI component, which has no need for an alternate JavaScript runtime or a large opaque payload. Executing a second runtime specifically to run an obfuscated bundle bypasses Node-based static scanners and hides the true behavior of the install-time payload.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
